items.text: on desktop and iPad the popovers float: drag one by its grip, let go near an edge and it snaps there, pin it to keep it open while you play; double-tap the grip to send it home
pop out: the index moves into its own window beside the stage (desktop); the duck-rabbit brings it back
manual: print the index as a manual, or save it as a PDF, with a cover, contents and every section opened out
cards with the QR code leave out the small duck-rabbit in the lower right, so the code stands alone in that corner
add: Beat: eleven starter beats to load into the grid, from boom bap and dembow to son clave and a Euclidean rhythm
cards can carry the QR code again, as a choice: no code (the default) or QR code, beside branding. The code opens the exact look; its tile is the namemark's width
the Dimitry Saïd Chamy namemark is his vector file now, sharp at any size (in the corner and on cards)
every saved or shared image carries, in its metadata, that it was made with Current by CHAMY·XYZ, with the version, the address and its file name; nothing about you
the anonymous counter counts every card saved or shared (it counted one per visit), and whether it was branded
cards with no branding: the look alone, full bleed, with its texture and your own message if you write one; sharing it sends no link to the app
